quantifier.formula: For every actual persistent terminal-first-surviving proper-root receipt S with 2<=h<p, m=3, 5|D_star, D_star>1, and no already-active physical serializer, route S through R1 or R2 and close every emitted leaf as FAMILY_EMPTY, TERMINAL, or VERIFIED_SUCCESSOR(E1-E5).
quantifier.terminal_priority: terminal-first before raw policy, carrier routing, or enqueue

owned_residuals.predicate: owned quantifier holds and required raw suffix/path digest is absent or not bound to the persistent parent
owned_residuals.closure_meaning: Bind a canonical replayable source path and priority misses; the path-binding artifact is an E1 prerequisite and is not itself a recursive edge.

owned_residuals.predicate: owned quantifier holds, raw path and priority misses are bound, and no active serializer accepts the first-child/policy endpoint
owned_residuals.closure_meaning: Produce a deterministic target or terminal certificate with common admission, universal lift, owner, and strict parent-to-final T5 ticket.

established_inputs.boundary: m=3,q=5 raw policy, first-child L1, and p^2 reduction; no L1=L_omega inference
L_omega=E_u E_v at the recanonicalized endpoint; EMPTY/TERMINAL/PAID closure remains open

forbidden_inferences: higher p-adic congruence alone closes a residual

raw path or arithmetic checkpoint is a persistent successor

fixture or finite scan proves family emptiness
family label proves E3 owner or recursive re-entry

R1 path binding is silently assumed for R2
low-height results apply to h>p or m!=3 slices
